units.source_text: 古歌：“缁衣修道处，何用女郎花？

en.t: An old poem says: In a place where black robes are worn to cultivate the Way, what use is there for maiden flowers?

units.source_text: 人世多谣诼，传闻殊不佳。”

en.t: The human world is full of slander, and the rumors that spread are especially unpleasant.
This appears in the Later Collection of Japanese Poems.
